set.body:
Current release queue, 7 October 2026: release-1.0; milestone-mapping.
Plan: docs/refactor/RELEASE-QUEUE.md. Mote remains authoritative; one primary agent and at most one helper.

Reconciliation: Acceptance retained; this audit did not run its proposed tests.

Remaining / next action: Implement public strict local reference directly from checked immutable local evidence, before GraphHsmm. Prove chronology/ID/order isolation, tie-complete candidates, unavailable versus uninformative outcomes, and matching reference/HSMM evidence digest.

Release tags schedule work; they do not establish completion or empirical qualification. Use current AGENTS.md for ownership, scoped gates and exact-SHA review; old fleet roles, timers and fixed gate task counts are historical. Keep the original scientific preregistration, denominators, admission and sealed-test rules below.

Retained acceptance and design context:

Governing plan: docs/refactor/PLAN.md (2026-09-19); ADR 0019. Key: reference; lane: next.

Scope: align reference inference, embed-bench StageTrace adapter

Acceptance criteria:
1. Pure public reference operation consumes checked immutable local evidence without first running GraphHsmm. Reuse stable local normalization from StageTrace; initially deterministic lexical scoring plus vetted existing channels. No transitions/refinement/monotone decoder/fill.
2. State target universe, one grain/hierarchy cut, prior weights, temperature, normalization and external alternatives; reject duplicate target identity. Missing computation is not uniform evidence; distinguish successful indistinguishable evidence from unavailable scores.
3. Restricted retrieval/render/scorer inputs contain opaque target IDs and content, not playback positions, chronological numbers/list order or prior assignments. Source coordinates are supplied separately to readouts.
4. Fixed-packet permutation preserves each packet mapping after ID reconciliation; source storage permutation and bijective opaque-ID rename preserve results. Equal-score shortlist ties are tie-complete or refused, never chronology/ID-truncated. Freeze floating tolerances before runs.
5. Identical candidates/scores/receipt digest feed reference and HSMM paths. Anti-tests injecting chronology, previous assignments, sequential external preference or refined emissions fail. Uniform evidence remains flagged uninformative and uncalibrated.

Validation: proposed ReferenceMeasurementSuite and ReferenceIsolationSuite on all align platforms; StageTrace parity suite

Completion evidence: exact baseline/result SHA, executable command and bound test totals/exit, artifact digests, discriminating failure injection, compatibility impact, separate SD6 review. Run reference-scope for the actual diff and SD2 checkAll before landing. Proposed suite names below are acceptance specifications, not existing or executed tests. No efficacy claim follows from a synthetic pass.

Boundary: No contextual reference inference or statistical calibration in this slice.
